data_source.query:
FROM kibana_sample_data_logs
| EVAL type = CASE(TO_INTEGER(response.keyword) >= 400 and TO_INTEGER(response.keyword) < 500, "4xx", "Other")
| STATS count = COUNT(*) by type
| EVAL count_4xx = CASE(type == "4xx", count), count_rest = CASE(type == "Other", count)
| DROP count, type
| STATS count_4xx = MAX(count_4xx), count_rest = MAX(count_rest)
| EVAL percentage = ROUND(count_4xx / TO_DOUBLE(count_4xx + count_rest), 3)
| RENAME percentage as `HTTP 4xx (%)`
| DROP count_4xx, count_rest
